description: Call this first. Returns one topic of Jabbertoon's guide as Markdown (under 20,000 characters): start (what it makes and the order of calls), cartoon (the JSON program: cast, scenes, lines, moves), text (the same cartoon as screenplay text), moves, characters, looks, voices, places, errors, limits, build (the 3D builder's steps), export (a build as a 3D printer's STL or 3MF, glTF for Blender, SVG blueprints, Minecraft), world (a world of blocks), walk (a place to walk), game (a game's steps), song (the editor's own file: Studio characters, lines, moves, camera shots and a song the cast sings), market. Units everywhere: x and y are shares of the stage (0 to 1, the ground at 0.92), times are seconds. Example: {"topic": "cartoon"}.

topic.description: Leave it out for start, which names the others.

name: get_guide
title: Read Jabbertoon's guide for writing a cartoon
